_comment: Per-flow click/time baselines for the performance ratchet (CLAUDE.md §13). CAPTURE MODE: all flows are being recounted to reflect REAL user interactions (every field fill/tap/keystroke = 1, not 1 per evaluate-block). Once the honest numbers stabilize in CI, copy each flow's reported click count here to start HARD-GATING it. A flow listed here may not increase its click count vs baseline; improvements ratchet it DOWN. Time is advisory only.

lifecycle/lead-to-paid-tm.note: Whole-business floor (2026-07-14 capture): lead 57 + T&M estimate 19 + send 1 + client sign 24 + realtime popup 0 + schedule 2 + time 2 + complete 2 + final pay 7. 2026-07-21 +2 (upper bound) for the new REQUIRED 'Who is this?' party-type pick at the top of the lead form; re-tighten to exact count on next live capture. Raise ONLY for a deliberate new lifecycle step, in the same commit.

lifecycle/lead-to-paid-byo.note: Whole-business floor, BYO variant (2026-07-14 capture). 2026-07-21 +2 (upper bound) for the new REQUIRED 'Who is this?' party-type pick; re-tighten on next live capture. The 90-click estimate step is the standing streamline target (templates/price-book).

qr-leads/scan-to-labeled-lead.note: Lowered from 132 (2026-07-29): 'QR codes' is now a direct button on the Leads tbar instead of a link buried inside the 'Get leads' share-link modal (owner feedback: even the builder couldn't find it), removing 1 tap from each of the 2 navigations to pg-qr-leads in this flow. Breakdown: create source 28 + anon scan/form submit 89 + event/label verify 0 + promote 2 + log cost 11.

places/receipt-becomes-supply-house.note: First capture 2026-08-01 (chromium + webkit, self-hosted flow-local, real Supabase): log a stamped receipt 1 + place created 1 + settings-race probe 1 + sofa-paperwork negative 1 + sign out and back in 2. The negative case is load-bearing and must stay: paperwork done at home in the evening must NOT promote someone's living room to a supply house.

places/drive-attribution.note: ZERO on purpose (2026-08-01, chromium + webkit, self-hosted flow-local, real Supabase). An earlier capture counted simulated GPS pings as interactions; a ping is not one. The contractor never taps, clocks in, clocks out, or classifies a single minute of this, so the honest user cost is nothing at all. Zero is also the stronger gate: any tap ever added to the automatic path puts the flow over budget and fails CI. Covers a supply run out and back, plus the commute guard.

crew/location-consent-is-real.note: First capture 2026-08-01 (chromium + webkit, self-hosted flow-local, real Supabase): sign-in 1 + the acknowledgment tap 1 + owner roster read 1. Reading the notice costs 0 on purpose. This one must never ratchet DOWN to 0 on the tap: an acknowledgment that costs no interaction is an acknowledgment nobody made, which is the fabricated-consent bug this whole spec exists to prevent.

The contractor never taps, clocks in, clocks out, or classifies a single minute of this, so the honest user cost is nothing at all. Zero is also the stronger gate: any tap ever added to the automatic path puts the flow over budget and fails CI. Covers a whole day: shop, job, supply house, lunch, job, shop.

An earlier capture counted simulated GPS pings as interactions; a ping is not one. Zero is also the stronger gate: any tap ever added to the automatic path puts the flow over budget and fails CI. Covers the chain: home office, job, supply house, job, job, shop.

fleet/vehicle-survives-resignin.note: First capture 2026-07-31 (chromium, self-hosted flow-local): add vehicle 20 + odometer 1 + rename 23 + settings-race 1 + sign-out/in 2. Raised 2026-08-03 by the license plate, which this PR made REQUIRED once a fleet holds more than one vehicle: the plate is now typed as part of adding a truck, so the cost is real and deliberate rather than a regression. The 23-click rename is inflated by retyping the whole name (the type() helper clears the field), and 20 of the add is typing the vehicle name, so the real nav cost here is still small. Standing streamline target: reaching Fleet & Team on a phone still costs 2 taps through the More menu.

topeka-day.note: A whole working day, captured live 2026-08-02: home office to client to Home Depot to lunch to client to estimate to home. ONE tap for the entire day, confirming the suggested name for the supply stop. Every leg, every mileage row and every minute is logged with no interaction at all, which is the point: the day costs the contractor one tap.

crew-lunch.note: Buying the crew lunch, captured live 2026-08-02. Job to supply house to lunch to job: the whole drive logs itself with no taps. The single interaction is logging the receipt, which the contractor keeps anyway, and it is that receipt that turns the stop from a personal detour into business miles.

two-device-drive.note: Two trucks logging drives in the same minute, captured live 2026-08-03. ZERO taps is the whole point: the geofence writes both legs by itself and neither device's save removes the other's row. Any tap appearing here means a drive stopped logging itself.

manual-drive.note: Tapping Drive part-way through a journey the geofence is already watching, captured live 2026-08-02. Two taps, start and end. The measured geocode-to-geocode row is what survives; the typed number never becomes a second trip.

crew-mileage-sync.note: An employee's own-car trip syncing and staying out of the owner's deduction, captured live 2026-08-02. One tap to open the mileage page; the trip itself is logged by the geofence.

crew-mileage-sync/employee-view.note: What the crew member's own device is handed by the server, captured live 2026-08-03. One tap to open the mileage page.
